BillingVerificationError.description: Returned with HTTP 503 when paid access cannot be confirmed right now: the billing provider is re-verifying a recently expired subscription, or the entitlement backend is unreachable. Retryable — honor Retry-After.

code.description: Machine-readable billing-verification state, mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header.

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint, when the denial came from a tier gate.

CalendarEvent.description: CalendarEvent is one holiday or observance relevant to marketing planning.

items.description: Marketing category ids the event is relevant to.

date.description: Calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD; a date, not a timestamp.

DemandTrend.description: DemandTrend is a demand series for one marketing category.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

ForbiddenError.description: Returned when a PRO-gated endpoint denies access because the caller has no resolved authenticated user, entitlements cannot be verified, or the caller lacks the required entitlement tier.

code.description: Machine-readable denial code, present when the 403 is a billing-provider-confirmed subscription lapse (mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header).

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint.

GatewayError.description: Returned by gateway infrastructure errors before an RPC handler runs, such as origin, routing, method, authentication, or quota checks.

error.description: Gateway error reason or structured gateway failure details.

GetDemandTrendsRequest.description: GetDemandTrendsRequest selects marketing categories and US states.

items.description: Marketing category ids to include; an empty list means all categories.
Two-letter US state codes to localize trends to.

GetDemandTrendsResponse.description: GetDemandTrendsResponse carries category demand series and trending terms.

degraded.description: True when an upstream source failed and the lists may be incomplete.

InvalidRequestBodyError.description: Returned when a JSON POST request body is empty or malformed.

JmespathProjectionError.description: Returned when a REST jmespath projection is invalid or exceeds the expression/output byte limits.

original_keys.description: Top-level keys or shape of the unprojected response.

ListCalendarEventsRequest.description: ListCalendarEventsRequest selects a date window and marketing categories.

items.description: Marketing category ids to include; an empty list means all categories.

fromDate.description: First date of the window, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

toDate.description: Last date of the window, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

ListCalendarEventsResponse.description: ListCalendarEventsResponse carries the events inside the requested window.

degraded.description: True when an upstream source failed and the list may be incomplete.

ListWeatherAlertsRequest.description: ListWeatherAlertsRequest selects the US states to read active alerts for.

items.description: Two-letter uppercase US state codes, such as TX or CA.

ListWeatherAlertsResponse.description: ListWeatherAlertsResponse carries the active alerts for the requested states.

degraded.description: True when an upstream source failed and the list may be incomplete.

Mention.description: Mention is one news article that matched a client's terms.

clientId.description: Roster client id the mention matched.

lat.description: Latitude of the mention; 0,0 means no location and the browser uses the client location.

lon.description: Longitude of the mention; 0,0 means no location and the browser uses the client location.

publishedAt.description: Publication time, Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

MentionQuery.description: MentionQuery is one client's search terms and location.

city.description: City used to localize the search.

clientId.description: Roster client id the results belong to.

stateCode.description: Two-letter US state code used to localize the search.

items.description: Search terms for this client, such as its business name.

RateLimitError.description: Returned when a gateway or handler rate limit rejects the request.

SearchLocalMentionsRequest.description: SearchLocalMentionsRequest carries per-client search queries in the POST body.

SearchLocalMentionsResponse.description: SearchLocalMentionsResponse carries the mentions found for the queries.

degraded.description: True when an upstream source failed and the list may be incomplete.

TrendPoint.description: TrendPoint is one sample of a demand series.

date.description: Sample date, Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

value.description: Relative demand value for the sample.

TrendingTerm.description: TrendingTerm is one currently trending search term.

geo.description: Geography the term is trending in, such as US or US-TX.

traffic.description: Approximate traffic label from the source, such as "50K+".

UnauthorizedError.description: Returned when the API key is missing, malformed, or lacks current API access.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

WeatherAlert.description: WeatherAlert is one active NWS alert that touches a client service area.

event.description: NWS event name, such as "Winter Storm Warning".

expires.description: Alert expiry time, Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

headline.description: Short NWS headline for the alert.

onset.description: Alert onset time, Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

polygonGeojson.description: Alert shape as a GeoJSON geometry string; empty when no shape is known.

severity.description: Mapped severity bucket: info, watch or warning.

items.description: Two-letter US state codes the alert covers.
NWS zone codes the alert covers.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated idempotency key. Retrying a POST with the same key and an identical request body replays the original response (only the status, body, and Content-Type are reproduced) instead of re-executing; reusing the key with a different body is rejected with 422. For mutations this avoids duplicating the side effect, while for batch-read POSTs it replays a cached snapshot that can be up to 24 hours stale. Keys are scoped per authenticated caller (falling back to the source IP for unauthenticated endpoints) and retained for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key echoed from the request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response was replayed from an earlier request with the same key, false on the first (original) request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.
